notes:
Inbound lead from product team via self-serve signup. Primarily evaluating Hosted API for support assistant MVP. Main theme: data privacy + retention. Shorthand notes from calls and threads:

- 2026-02-25: initial signup, sandbox keys created. basic smoke tests done (latency ~120ms on short prompts).
- 2026-02-28: discovery call (FF id ff_20260228_8372). Attendees: Maya T. (AE), Evan P. (SE), Caroline (PM, SparkBridge), Rahul (Eng).
  - Caroline: "We want absolute clarity on what you store and for how long. Some of our customers require opt-out for transcripts."
  - Rahul: asks about whether prompts are stored in cleartext, and whether we offer prompt hashing + ephemeral cache.
- 2026-03-02: follow-up email thread (gmail_thread_12ab34cd) requesting retention SLA and example deletion flow.
- 2026-03-04: security checklist submitted, flagged items: SSO/SAML support, audit logging retention, ability to disable request logging per API key. Ticket INF-2219 logged to capture PII removal options.

Use-case / requirements summary:
- workload: support-agent (primary), short-answer summarization (secondary).
- latency target: p99 < 300ms for single-turn assistance; generally low concurrency (burst to 50 qps).
- cost sensitivity: high, SMB budget. expecting hosted per-token pricing.
- model preference: prefer smaller/faster models for latency/cost, but want fallback to higher-quality variant for edge cases.
- routing/fallback: care about region routing (us-east) and fallback to quantized variant if capacity constrained.
- security/compliance: require SSO for admin UI, audit logs retained 12 months, ability to opt-out a subset of customer interactions from retention.

POC / evaluation plan:
- POC scope: integrate hosted API for 2 support teams, ~3k conversations over 30 days. objective: accuracy + latency + verify retention opt-out works.
- Milestones: sandbox -> staged API keys -> demo integration -> 30d POC -> decision.

Action items / next steps (short):
- AE (Maya): send retention SLA draft (attached drive:/security/retention-faq.md) by 2026-03-06.
- SE (Evan): prepare short doc on prompt storage options (hashing, ephemeral modes) and an example curl flow to opt-out logging per request.
- Schedule security call w/ Caroline + Rahul week of 2026-03-15 to review audit logs and deletion flow.

Open questions / blockers:
- Can hosted API support per-request opt-out flag (customer asked for header like X-Redwood-DoNotStore)? we have suggested approaches but need product confirmation.
- Data residency: SparkBridge operates primarily in us-east but some customers in EU — they asked if region pinning available on hosted plan (they prefer public cloud regional routing rather than Private).
- Need concrete SLA language re: default log retention period and permanent deletion timeframe after opt-out.

CRM style quick snippets:
- "If we can guarantee opt-out and show deletion proof, we can move to POC." — Caroline
- "Budget small, need clear low-cost plan + low latency." — Rahul
